source: fintwittruth src/lib/demo-data.ts and market-history.json. Handles and wording are the seeded demo book. Levels are offsets from recorded Friday Yahoo Finance closes. directionGrade compares the stated direction with the Monday regular-session open versus that Friday close. It is not the live board peer-rank GC score.
